summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 7, 2026. Shareholders re-elected all seven board members (five non-executive) for one-year terms and approved all resolutions. No specific terms, prices, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics were disclosed. The filing is a routine post-meeting report, constituting a standard corporate governance event. There is no special situation transaction, activist campaign, or strategic change. As a routine AGM results announcement under a foreign private issuer filing, it maps to a customary current report on Form 8-K Item 5.07. No risk-arb or transactional angle exists.
